layout_and_spacing.strategy: Generous Spacing, Mobile-first, Grid Bento for Dashboards, Center Focus for Typing interface.

surfaces_and_components.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#12121A]/70 border-b border-white/10. Sticky top-0 z-50.
surfaces_and_components.cards: Retro-Futuristic flat dark background with 1px border (border-white/10). Hover: subtle lift (-translate-y-1) and neon glow shadow (shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.1)]). Sharp edges or max rounded-sm.

buttons.primary: bg-[#00F0FF] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-white hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.6)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:border-[#FF003C] hover:text-[#FF003C] transition-all

surfaces_and_components.typing_interface: Neo-brutalist / terminal vibe. Big font sizes, distinct colors for correct (Neon Cyan #00F0FF), incorrect (Plasma Magenta #FF003C), and pending (muted gray #52525B) characters. Blinking terminal cursor.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Text color brightens, subtle neon drop-shadows on borders, slight scaling.
motion_and_interactions.typing_feedback: Instant character color change. Screen shake or red flash overlay on error (Boss mode only).

image_urls.description: Cyberpunk city street at night, neon lights. Used for Landing Hero.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `lucide-react`, `framer-motion` (for micro-interactions), `recharts` (for dashboard metrics).

Create a hybrid Dark theme utilizing Tailwind. Configure tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors (e.g., 'neon-cyan': '#00F0FF') and import Google fonts (Outfit, Bebas Neue, Manrope, JetBrains Mono).
Ensure the typing interface relies heavily on JetBrains Mono, clearly differentiating right/wrong/upcoming characters. Avoid standard form inputs for the typing logic; listen to raw keyboard events.
Boss Mode must include a visible HP bar that depletes based on WPM and Accuracy over a set duration or passage length.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="typing-input-area"`).
Do not use generic UI cards. Implement custom sharp or slightly rounded divs with 1px border and hover glows, following the 'Retro-Futuristic' surface rules.
Ensure proper spacing between sections. The hero should feel cinematic with the overlaid cyberpunk image.
Do not invent new pages outside of the scope. Stick to Landing, Auth, Dashboard, Lessons, Quotes, Typing Practice, Boss Fight, Achievements, Leaderboard, Profile.
